normal-cordon-time-record.method: Native requestAnimationFrame/normal START; legal project-specific right steering (desktop after five seconds, mobile from START). No simulation stepping, police placement, health, speed, mission or reinforcement edits. Internal rendering resolution reduced while running; screenshots at device-independent 1x resolution.

permanent-wreck-time-record.method: Collision/health fixture for initial explosion; fixed 60Hz simulation updates for age 1/30/60/61/62 seconds, no elapsed-time assignments. Two officers naturally respawn first; empty police fixture then isolates long-duration persistence. Forty further explosion fixtures exercise old-cap overflow. Observer camera only moves; wreck positions are unchanged.

v17-natural-chase-record.method: Normal START; native RAF; legal stageDriver(2,evasive) steering only. No simulation stepping, police/health placement or forced explosions.
